mapper.select: WITH ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION AS ( SELECT S.UNIV_ID, S.PLAN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY S.UNIV_ID ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL ) SELECT U.UNIV_ID AS univId, U.UNIV_NAME AS univName, P.PLAN_NAME AS planName, P.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT AS maxMemberCount, COUNT(M.MEMBER_ID) AS currentMemberCount FROM UNIVERSITY U JOIN ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND S.RN = 1 JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND M.STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED') WHERE U.UNIV_ID = #{univId} GROUP BY U.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, P.PLAN_NAME, P.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT
